featured_reviews.name: Gupta Rohit
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a nice place for fish/prawns buying. Market starts at 7 AM. You have to be tough negotiator here. Do not be in rush to buy, there are plenty of options, be careful while buying, there are chances you may be robbed of old fishes. You can get all the items chopped and cleaned, there are seperate people who cleans it up for you. I came across the cleaning chopping lady Gauri, if you are a noob in buying she can help you with good buy. If you have more time you can visit Bhau cha Dhakka but than it takes more to travel and you will have to be early bird and experienced to negotiate and have good find.

featured_reviews.review_text: Nice place for fish. But please bargain.

featured_reviews.name: Ganesh Patkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Fresh fish available here, one must know how to bargain.

featured_reviews.name: vipul chamur (OFFICIAL VIPUL)
featured_reviews.review_text: Versova koli wada is nice with culture fisheries local womens selling fish while their husband or male person going for fishing  at sea. As they called them sagar devta as well as their  typical local language koli sounds so good.

featured_reviews.name: Shishir Deshpande
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent for fresh sea food and sea food lovers who like cooking. A wide variety of fresh catch is available with fish like Pomphrets, Prawns / Shrimps, Crabs, lobsters et al.
The fresh catch comes every alternate day from the aversive jetty where the trawlers arrive every alternate days or so.
It’s a historical place in its own way.

featured_reviews.name: asif sharief shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good place for holesale fish in all variety

featured_reviews.name: Salim Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Fish market at Andheri west Versova. You need to have good bargain skills to buy anything from here. The sellers are quite humble and polite,  but also be ready to get insulted if you are trying to bargain at a very low price below the expected lowest price and when you irritate them. Don't get emotionally carried away with the stories the sellers might try to sell. They will never sell even at their cost price. And the term 'bony karo' will be heard a lot. Don't get carried away. They will never give away unless they make profits. Generally the fishes are quite fresh and good to eat. The quantity matters for a good deal.

featured_reviews.name: Manish Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a good place if you need to buy fish in large quantities. You will find fresh & good quality of Prawns, Surmai, Pomfret, Bangda & Bombayduck. Make sure to be there between 8AM to 9:30AM. Because after this time it is the small retailers who sell there. And if you want to get the fish cleaned : de-shelling the prawns, cleaning Bombayduck etc. you can get it done from small errand boys and girls who will do it for 30-50 Rs. Also be prepared to dare thru some fish slurry on the floor and ofcourse the STRONG  stench of fish.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent place for FreshCatch especially if one lands up there around 8/8:30 am or thereabouts. The fish comes off the boats around 5 am or so and lands up at the Versova Village Fish Market by 8 am.
One can really bargain here and get fresh fish for reasonable prices, having said that ‘reasonable’ is really relative as seafood due to over fishing and environmental challenges has become quite expensive.
A must visit for seafood lovers for a home cooked meal!!

featured_reviews.name: Deepak
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fish World is hands down the best place for aquarium lovers! The staff are incredibly knowledgeable and always take the time to answer questions, whether you’re new to fishkeeping or an experienced hobbyist. Their tanks are spotless, and the fish are always healthy, active, and well cared for — which really shows the pride they take in their work.
They also have a fantastic variety, from colorful community fish to unique species you don’t see everywhere, plus a wide selection of aquarium supplies, plants, and decor. Prices are fair, and the advice they give is priceless. Every time I walk in, I leave not only with what I need but also feeling more confident about caring for my fish.
Highly recommend Fish World to anyone looking for quality fish, great selection, and amazing customer service! 🐠✨

featured_reviews.name: Jairaj Gaurkar (Jay)
featured_reviews.review_text: Precihole NX200 Athena is a solid airgun with great build quality and an impressive design. It feels sturdy and well-balanced during use. Accuracy and performance are both quite satisfying. The only issue I noticed is that it tends to get hot after around 8 to 10 shots, which could be improved by the company. Despite that, it's still a really nice gun overall and worth recommending.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Best sporting air rifle brand in India.
Very good quality products down the line and chimera x3 is one exceptional piece 👍🏻 very good accuracy and precise.
Match grade trigger which is a huge plus point 👌🏻

featured_reviews.name: Z Venu
featured_reviews.review_text: My first  experience with Precihole Sports products was the purchase of a NP60 Draco from The Airgun Store and really enjoyed using the air pistol for target practicing in my backyard. After going through a lot of reviews, I tried purchasing a PP100 Chimera BX3 and a PCP Pump from Precihole Sports. However, the bank transaction was denied because of the large amount involved. So, I ordered a PCP Pump from Precihole Sports and Bought the Chimera from another outlet Airgun Kart. So far, I am more than satisfied with the products I bought. The pump is sturdy and powerful and the Chimera looks as good as in the pics from the website.  Using a bushnell 3-9x40 eg scope, I am able to comfortably have 1 inch grouping at about 100 feet. The folding butt is another unique feature which was one of the reasons for choosing the chimera. Am also satisfied with the pricing and the packaging. All in all, am very much satisfied with precihole products.

featured_reviews.name: Konark Varma
featured_reviews.review_text: Mounted my Rifle with Bushnell Telescope and the precision is 100%. I recommend using WD 40 light layer onto Metal parts post usage so that there is no Rust and you keep using it for years. Carbon fibre mixed body is stylish and no need to own compressed gas cylinder is you are not looking for long range shots. Overall a killer product

featured_reviews.name: Hribhu Sarkar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had bought a precihole sports px100 match pro, the precision and quality of the air rifle is good enough, especially considering that the cost is quite low compared to imported products of similar to slightly better quality. Staff behaviour on phone calls/whatsapp is good too. Pretty much the only downside I faced is that they have very limited stock sometimes, with some products being out of stock, and they sell only a very limited quantity of pellets to a particular customer at a time (which is likely due to low stock in inventory).

featured_reviews.name: vishnu Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am reviewing PX100 Match pro Junior. My purpose was to have my minor daughter involved in training 10m target and holding practice for competetive shooting, before investing in imported rifles if she picks up on the sport. The air gun provides reasonably good features, a reasonable match grade sensitive trigger. Around 3.7 KGS weight, adjustable butt plate, cheek plate, full alluminium body, adjustable grip, manual safety. Below are some pro's and cons before considering a purchase.

Pro's:
1. Good beginners air rifle to practice competition shooting basics.
2. Smooth side cocking experience.
3. Reasonably good front and rear sight.
4. Adjustable cheekpiece and but plate.
5. Gives near match grade rifle like adjustments Made in India product.
6. Relatively less expensive than imported counterparts.

Cons:
1. While its a match grade junior air rifle, some aspects could have been better engineered. Like the trigger adjustment needs removal of foreend of stock block, which if removed would displace the nut holding the foreend of the stock. Its a challenge to get the nut in place to put the stock foreend fixed back.
2. It claims it gives precision air discharge, still it doesn't have a regulater. Would be a good to have a regulated match grade air rifle at this price.
3. The companies warranty is carry in only. I had the incident where a representative asked to carry in from Bangalore to Mumbai for a nut issue on a rear sight riser block or ship the defective one and pay the company to ship me a replacement for a 1 week old air rifle. Quite inconvenient for customers purchasing from outside Mumbai location. Company may have to rethink this term. While company reconsidered and shipped it for me at companies expense after raising a concern, Preciole should think on simplifying this term make services eazy.
3. Quality of the nuts could have been better. One of the nut lost its threading and took almost 4 days to get my replacement riser block and nuts. Simple spare screwsset provided along with  product would have been cost effective and hazzle free one. These screws are not easily available outside.
5. The air rifle is quite loud despite having a suppressor.

This is my honest opinion feel free to make ur choice considering these pro's and cons. Overall I would say good buy for junior to get into the sport. I feel the company have immense potential to give a good competiyion to global manufacturers if minor issues can be fixed. I have not used the air rifle in a match yet, I may update my review based on my daughters experience.

Thanks & Regards,
Vishnu

featured_reviews.name: Dinesh Kumar Das
featured_reviews.review_text: I've had an excellent experience with Precihole Sports! The quality and precision of their air rifles and shooting equipment are truly outstanding. You can tell they put a lot of care into engineering and craftsmanship. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned shooter, their products deliver consistent performance and reliability. Customer service is also very responsive and helpful. Proud to support an Indian company that's setting high standards in arms and ammunition manufacturing. Highly recommended. 😊👍
